test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A can do a piece of work in 4 days. B can do it in 20 days. With the assistance of C, they completed the work in 2 days. C alone can do it in _______ days.
solution:
**Given:**

A can do a piece of work in 4 days.

B can do a piece of work in 20 days.

With the assistance of C, they completed the work in 2 days.

**Formula used:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/4

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/20&
